internal_discovery.plain_explanation: Across verbs, verbal-nouns, participles, the causative, the elative and the intensive feminine, the root means 'to go past the proper bound.' This is fixed by three non-moral anchors a moral gloss cannot survive: the Flood-water that 'ṭaghā' (overflowed its confines, 69:11), the Prophet's gaze that did NOT 'ṭaghā' (did not overshoot its object, 53:17, contrasted with zāgha 'swerve'), and the command not to 'ṭaghā' in the balance (over-weigh, 55:8). Applied to human conduct this yields the familiar tyranny/self-exaltation sense (Pharaoh 'innahu ṭaghā', 'those who ṭaghaw in the land', man who 'la-yaṭghā' when he deems himself self-sufficient). The state-noun ṭughyān is what one is 'in' and wanders blind within, and it can be quantitatively increased (ṭughyānan kabīran, 17:60). The one class that does NOT reduce to this is ṭāghūt: a reified, worshipped, appealed-to, fought-for false authority/deity opposed to Allah — a referential thing, not an act of exceeding.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: Tgy is NOT: (1) disbelief — ṭughyān is coordinated with, hence distinct from, kufr ('ṭughyānan wa-kufran', 18:80, 5:64, 5:68); (2) wrongdoing/ẓulm as such — coordinated with and separable from it ('aẓlama wa-aṭghā', 53:52); (3) lateral deviation/swerve — explicitly opposed to zāgha (53:17); (4) mere precipitance/neglect — listed as a separate hazard from faraṭa (20:45); (5) intrinsically moral or agentive — water (69:11) and a destroying calamity (69:5) take it with no culpable agent; (6) directional deficiency — always excess/over-much (overflow, over-weigh, self-exalt), never falling short; (7) 'idol/false god' as a root sense — that reading is carried ONLY by the fixed form ṭāghūt, never by any verb or masdar.
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: ṭāghūt (esp. 5:60:20:2 'wa-ʿabada al-Ṭāghūt' and 39:17:3:2 'al-Ṭāghūt an yaʿbudūhā'): worship (ʿabada) takes ṭāghūt as a direct definite object with a feminine resumptive pronoun (-hā) — ṭāghūt is a thing that can be worshipped and pronominalized, not an action of overstepping a bound, which cannot be the grammatical object of ʿabada. Its referent is also number-unstable within the packet (singular 'bihi' 4:60 vs. plural agent 'awliyāʾuhum al-Ṭāghūt yukhrijūnahum' 2:257), the hallmark of an independent lexicalized noun. No ṭāghūt verse contains any ṭaghā verb and no verse glosses ṭāghūt from the root, so its 'false-deity-because-of-excess' derivation is asserted, never Quran-internally demonstrated.
internal_discovery.strongest_competitor: That the nucleus is moral-theological rebellion/tyranny against rightful (divine) authority, with water/scale/gaze as metaphorical extensions. It is strong on raw frequency (~30/39 sit in exactly such contexts). It is rejected as the CORE because it is disproven by 69:11 (water overflows), 53:17 (the gaze that did not overshoot), and 55:8 (over-weighing a balance), where 'rebellion against God' is incoherent but 'exceed the proper measure' fits exactly. internal_discovery.rationale: All three independent lenses converge: a broad, distinctive, adversarially-clean nucleus 'overstep/exceed a proper bound' transparently bridges 31/39 occurrences (12 base verbs, 1 causative Form IV, 10 masdar ṭughyān/ṭaghwā, 6 agent participles ṭāghīn/ṭāghūn, 1 elative aṭghā, 1 intensive ṭāghiya), differentiated from neighbours by internal coordination/contrast (kufr, ẓulm, zāgha, faraṭa). However ṭāghūt (8/39 ≈ 21%) is a resistant, morphologically opaque, referential, number-unstable lexicalized noun whose meaning cannot be predicted from the nucleus — bridged only conceptually ('overstepping-of-God reified'), never derivationally or by any Quran-internal gloss. independent_verification: Three independent lenses (A, B, adversary C) each independently reached the same nucleus and the same single resistant class (ṭāghūt), with no lens able to bridge it Quran-internally.
candidate_root_contribution: To exceed / overstep a proper limit or set measure — to go beyond the bound. Value-neutral at core (water overflows, the gaze stays on its mark, the scale is over-weighed), specialized against God-set limits into insolent overreach / self-exalting transgression when predicated of agents. The nucleus transparently generates the masdar (the state of excess one is immersed in and can be increased), the agent participles (those who overstep), the causative (to make overstep), the elative (more overstepping), and the intensive (the overwhelming/exceeding force). It does NOT compositionally generate the lexicalized noun ṭāghūt.

layer_attribution.occurrence_evidence: 39/39 occurrences read from packet _54_gy.json with Tanzil verse_text and QAC morphology; non-moral anchors 69:11 (water), 53:17 (gaze), 55:8 (scale) and boundary contrasts (kufr 18:80/5:64/5:68, ẓulm 53:52, zāgha 53:17, faraṭa 20:45) are the primary evidential base.
layer_attribution.derivation: One nucleus 'exceed/overstep a proper bound' generates the base verb (C1), causative Form IV (C2), masdar ṭughyān/ṭaghwā as state-noun (C3), agent participles and the elative (C4), and the intensive force-noun ṭāghiya (C5) — 31/39 transparently.
layer_attribution.lexical_class: ṭāghūt (C6, 8/39) is a lexicalized, morphologically opaque, number-unstable referential noun ('false object of worship / counter-authority to Allah') that does not compositionally reduce to the nucleus and is bridged only by asserted etymology.
layer_attribution.contextual_relation: Narrative/contextual identifications (Pharaoh, Thamūd, Noah's people, People of the Book) and the anti-God framing of ṭāghūt are context, not root meaning; the moral 'tyranny/insolent overreach' reading is the neutral nucleus specialized to the agent-vs-divine-limit domain and must NOT be elevated to the root's core.
layer_attribution.reconciliation: ṭāghiya (69:5) moved from preliminary RESISTANT to final CONSISTENT via the intra-sura bridge 69:11; the eight ṭāghūt occurrences remain final RESISTANT after review, capping the grade.
layer_attribution.unresolved_resistance: The ṭāghūt sub-class (8/39 ≈ 21%) is the persisting resistance: coherent as its own class but not Quran-internally bridged to the nucleus, which is why the result is MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE (DERIVATIONAL_FAMILY) rather than STRONG/UNIVERSAL, and not forced into a single unified sense.

hard_cases.reason: ṭāghūt is the direct object of worship (ʿabada), a reified entity, not an act of exceeding a bound.

evidence_basis.statement: wa-'abada al-Taghut: Taghut is the direct definite object of worship (عبد); an action of exceeding a bound cannot be the grammatical object of worship, so this is a reified entity, not the nucleus.

hard_cases.reason: ṭāghūt is worshipped with a feminine resumptive pronoun -hā; a pronominalizable worshipped thing.

evidence_basis.statement: al-Taghut an ya'buduha: worship with a feminine resumptive pronoun -ha; Taghut is a pronominalizable worshipped entity, non-compositional from 'overstep a bound'.

evidence_basis.statement: yakfur bi-l-Taghut wa yu'min bi-llah: Taghut is the object of disbelief set opposite belief in Allah, a reified anti-God pole, not an act of exceeding.

evidence_basis.statement: awliya'uhum al-Taghut yukhrijunahum: Taghut is an ally-agent taking a plural verb; a number-unstable reified noun, not a transparent derivative.

hard_cases.reason: ṭāghiya is a valence-reversed destroying force rather than a culpable agent; atypical but re-bridged within its own sura.

evidence_basis.statement: Thamud uhliku bi-l-Taghiya: the Tgy-word here is the overwhelming destroying force (a calamity), a valence reversal from the culpable agent, bridged by 69:11 taghā al-mā' (overflowing water as destroying excess) within the same sura.

hard_case_representation.rationale: The core 'exceed a proper bound' is PREFERRED and holds across the derivational family (C1–C5), so the result is not unresolved. But eight ṭāghūt occurrences constitute a genuine resistant lexicalized nominal seam that does not reduce to the nucleus; each is recorded as a RESISTANT_SEAM hard case with an evidence-derived syntactic/coordination basis, and ṭāghiya (69:5) is recorded as a structural atypicality reconciled to CONSISTENT.

rejection_condition.challenging_finding: A Quran-internal demonstration that ṭāghūt either (a) compositionally derives from the 'exceed a bound' nucleus — e.g. a ṭaghā verb co-occurring with or glossing ṭāghūt in the same verse — or conversely (b) that even the neutral verbal anchors (69:11 water, 53:17 gaze, 55:8 scale) require a moral 'rebellion' primitive rather than value-neutral excess, which would collapse the family/lexeme distinction or overturn the neutral core.
rejection_condition.search_location: The eight ṭāghūt verses (2:256, 2:257, 4:51, 4:60, 4:76, 5:60, 16:36, 39:17) checked for any co-occurring ṭaghā/ṭughyān form or internal gloss; and the neutral-anchor verses (69:11, 53:17, 55:8, 20:81) re-examined for a forced moral reading.
rejection_condition.verification_method: Re-read each cited verse_text against QAC morphology (qac_pos, qac_verb_form, surface form); test whether ṭāghūt ever alternates with a transparent participle or takes verbal complements of exceeding, and whether the neutral anchors admit a non-moral reading; confirm number agreement (sg bihi 4:60 vs pl yukhrijūnahum 2:257).
rejection_condition.confounder_control: Do not treat shared consonantal skeleton, classical lexica, or etymological 'excess→tyrant→idol' narratives as evidence; require an in-verse Quranic link, not an imported one; hold apart coordination (ṭughyān wa-kufr) from identity.
rejection_condition.failure_consequence: If ṭāghūt is Quran-internally bridged, upgrade toward STRONG/UNIVERSAL and fold C6 into the family; if the neutral core is overturned, downgrade to UNRESOLVED (unbridged moral vs. neutral classes) and abandon the single-nucleus claim.

reopen_conditions: If a verse is shown where a ṭaghā/ṭughyān verbal form co-occurs with or explicitly glosses ṭāghūt, re-test whether C6 folds into the derivational family and the scope rises toward UNIVERSAL.
If ṭāghiya (69:5) is argued to require a culpable-agent reading incompatible with 69:11 'ṭaghā al-māʾ', reopen the C5 reconciliation and the neutrality of the force-excess sense.

If the neutral anchors (69:11 water, 53:17 gaze, 55:8 scale) are re-analyzed as metaphors of a moral primitive, reopen the choice of nucleus (neutral 'exceed a bound' vs. moral 'rebellion') and reconsider MODERATE grading.
If ṭughyān's coordination with kufr (18:80, 5:64, 5:68) is shown to be appositional identity rather than distinctness, reopen the semantic_boundary claim that Tgy ≠ kufr.
